mentions.name: Bedtime Hero
mentions.description: A React Native app for iOS and Android that lets parents build and generate bedtime stories together with their child. Parents can use presets or set their own story parameters, and the app generates a story complete with images. The developer dogfoods it nightly with their own kid.
mentions.source_excerpt: Just wrapped up the latest build of Bedtime Hero - an application (React-Native, ios, android) for parents to build/generate bed time stories with their little one.  Allows the parent to use pre-sets or set their own and then generate a story (complete with images).
